originalTitle: What Happened To NuScale Power Stock Over The Past Year?

content:

NuScale Power (SMR) stock fell 81.6% in the year to November 10, 2026, while the S&P 500 returned 11.4%. Near the end of that year came the company’s fiscal Q3 2026 results on November 5, 2026, when management described its agreement with Doosan Enerbility to begin making the first NuScale power module, the company’s reactor. So what changed inside NuScale’s business over that year?

NuScale’s Revenue Has Almost Disappeared

NuScale reported revenue of $0.3 million for fiscal Q3 2026, compared with $8.2 million in the same quarter of 2025. On the November 5 call, management said the year-earlier quarter included front-end engineering and design work for the RoPower project, and that there was no comparable work this time. Over the full twelve months to September 2026, revenue came to $2.73 million , down from $63.9 million in the twelve months before.

No module sale has replaced that engineering work yet. Management said the sale of a module will come with an agreement between NuScale and ENTRA1 Energy, its commercialization partner, after ENTRA1 signs a power purchase agreement with TVA . On the same call, management said supporting that TVA agreement remains the company’s immediate priority.

What Are NuScale Shareholders Paying For Now?

The price appears to assume module sales that NuScale has yet to win. The stock trades at 785.1 times its sales over the last twelve months, compared with 3.2 times for the S&P 500. NuScale stock was not alone in falling over the same year, as Oklo, another nuclear company with little revenue so far, fell 78%.

The company spent more cash over the year, however. Free cash flow was negative $608 million over the twelve months to September 2026, compared with negative $282 million in the twelve months before.

NuScale Holds More Cash Than A Year Ago

NuScale ended September 2026 with $933 million in cash and short-term investments, against $692 million a year earlier. The business itself used cash over that time, so the rise came from outside the business. Its debt was $0.845 million, so the company still borrows almost nothing, as it did a year ago.

That cash is spread across many more shares, however. NuScale had 410 million diluted shares over the latest twelve months, compared with 148 million over the twelve months before. Part of that rise may reflect Fluor converting its Class B units into Class A stock, which NuScale said a year ago that Fluor could do.

NuScale’s cash balance is the figure to watch when it next reports, expected in February 2027.

chineseContent:

截至 2026 年 11 月 10 日的一年内，NuScale Power (SMR) 股价下跌 81.6%，而标准普尔 500 指数上涨 11.4%。临近年底，该公司于 2026 年 11 月 5 日发布了 2026 年第三季度财报，当时管理层描述了其与 Doosan Enerbility 达成协议，开始制造第一个 NuScale 功率模块，即该公司的反应堆。那么这一年 NuScale 的业务发生了哪些变化呢？

NuScale的收入几乎消失了

NuScale 公布的 2026 财年第三季度收入为 30 万美元，而 2025 年同一季度的收入为 820 万美元。在 11 月 5 日的电话会议上，管理层表示，上年同期包括 RoPower 项目的前端工程和设计工作，而这次没有类似的工作。截至 2026 年 9 月的整整 12 个月内，收入为 273 万美元，低于前 12 个月的 6390 万美元。

目前还没有任何模块销售能够取代该工程工作。管理层表示，在 ENTRA1 与 TVA 签署电力购买协议后，NuScale 与其商业化合作伙伴 ENTRA1 Energy 之间将达成协议，出售模块。在同一次电话会议上，管理层表示支持 TVA 协议仍然是公司的当务之急。

NuScale 股东现在付出了什么代价？

该价格似乎假设 NuScale 尚未赢得模块销售。该股过去 12 个月的市盈率为销售额的 785.1 倍，而标准普尔 500 指数的市盈率为 3.2 倍。NuScale 股票并不是唯一一家在同一年下跌的公司，另一家迄今为止收入很少的核电公司 Oklo 也下跌了 78%。

然而，该公司去年花费了更多现金。截至 2026 年 9 月的 12 个月内，自由现金流为负 6.08 亿美元，而此前 12 个月为负 2.82 亿美元。

NuScale 持有的现金比一年前更多

截至 2026 年 9 月，NuScale 拥有 9.33 亿美元的现金和短期投资，而上年同期为 6.92 亿美元。当时该公司本身使用现金，因此增长来自公司外部。它的债务为 84.5 万美元，因此该公司仍然像一年前一样几乎没有借钱。

然而，这些现金分散在更多的股票上。 NuScale 在最近 12 个月内拥有 4.1 亿股稀释后股票，而此前 12 个月内为 1.48 亿股。这一增长的部分原因可能是福陆将其 B 类单位转换为 A 类股票，NuScale 一年前表示福陆可以做到这一点。

NuScale 的现金余额是下一次报告时值得关注的数字，预计将于 2027 年 2 月发布。
